formal_statement: ¬ (∀ (N : ℕ) (I : Fin N → Fin N → Prop) [DecidableRel I] (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), (∀ p p' l l' : Fin N, p ≠ p' → l ≠ l' → ¬ (I p l ∧ I p l' ∧ I p' l ∧ I p' l')) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (N + N) C → (∀ z : Fin (N + N) → Bool, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (N + N) C z = true ↔ ∃ p l : Fin N, I p l ∧ z (Fin.castAdd N p) = true ∧ z (Fin.natAdd N l) = true) → ∃ D : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 D ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (N + N) D ∧ D.size ≤ C.size ∧ (∀ z : Fin (N + N) → Bool, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (N + N) D z = true ↔ ∃ p l : Fin N, I p l ∧ z (Fin.castAdd N p) = true ∧ z (Fin.natAdd N l) = true) ∧ (∀ j < D.gates.length, (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt D j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → ∀ z : Fin (N + N) → Bool, (D.wires (List.ofFn z)).getD (N + N + j) false = true → (D.wires (List.ofFn (fun ka : Fin (N + N) => decide (ka.val < N) && z ka))).getD (N + N + j) false = true ∨ (D.wires (List.ofFn (fun kb : Fin (N + N) => decide (N ≤ kb.val) && z kb))).getD (N + N + j) false = true ∨ ∃ p l : Fin N, I p l ∧ z (Fin.castAdd N p) = true ∧ z (Fin.natAdd N l) = true) ∧ (∀ j < D.gates.length, (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt D j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → (∀ p : Fin N, (D.wires (List.ofFn (fun kc : Fin (N + N) => decide (kc = Fin.castAdd N p)))).getD (N + N + j) false = false) ∧ ∀ l : Fin N, (D.wires (List.ofFn (fun kd : Fin (N + N) => decide (kd = Fin.natAdd N l)))).getD (N + N + j) false = false))
plain_statement: The negation of the statement: for N points and N lines with no two distinct points on two common lines, every circuit of AND/OR gates of fan-in at most two, each reading only earlier wires, true exactly when some point and a line through it are on, has a circuit of the same kind computing the same function with at most as many gates whose AND gates are false at each input with exactly one input on and, wherever true, stay true with all lines off, or all points off, or some incident pair on.
title: It is false that every 4-cycle-free N-by-N incidence circuit of fan-in-two AND/OR gates has a no-larger one with clean ANDs false at one-hot inputs
